title: load previous button doesnt work properly
body: I'm using the ais-infinite-hits widget and I have integrated the refinePrevious button and the refineNext button. If im starting on page 2 and click at the refinePrevious button everything works so far. But if i want to click on the refineNext button afterwards, nothing happens. I have to click the refineNext button twice to get the next results.

comments.body:
This was fixed in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4725, but not yet released, I'll cut a release now :)

release PR: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4730
awesome, will it be fixed for vue as well?
Yes, this will automatically be fixed for Vue once you update the dependencies!
